capabilities: Render {marker} syntax as SVG icon bullets in Live Preview and Reading view
Insert icon markers via a keyboard-and-mouse picker
Toggle markers between common and callout forms
Customize marker labels, colors, callout backgrounds, and SVG markup
Sanitize custom SVG input before storing and rendering
disambiguation: Not a checkbox-styling tool; despite the checkbox-styling-helper id, it renders icon bullets on ordinary list markers.
extras: The README's note says the existing checkbox-styling-helper plugin now provides a more complete icon bullet experience through Codex, suggesting a renamed or superseded line. The plugin is stated to be fully local with no telemetry or external requests.
problem: Obsidian list bullets are plain dashes, and icon-rich bullets usually depend on theme styling or HTML that breaks note portability.
summary: Renders plain-Markdown {marker} syntax as theme-independent SVG icon bullets and provides a picker for inserting them while writing.
